name: Model Info
description: Contributes the ModelInfo tool. The tool lets the model read its own current capabilities at call time: input modalities, context window, effort, caching, pricing and session details. It reads the current model snapshot through the plugin context (TUIContext.queryModelInfo). Thus it stays correct across a model or provider switch in a session, and after a resume, and it imports no provider. No provider duplicates it.

tool.name: ModelInfo
tool.description:
Show the active model and the functions that it has at this time. Use it before you tell the user that you cannot do a task. For example, you cannot accept an image or a file type. The model can change during a session or after `--resume`.

The tool gives the provider, the context window and the maximum output tokens. It also gives the input types, the `effort` levels, the cost and the `cwd`.
